name: @weichseltree/grove
description: The grove: research rooms, particle playback and a local demo for desktop, touch and WebXR.

scripts.demo: pnpm run dev:bundle && pnpm run dev --open /grove/?demo
scripts.deploy: pnpm run check:bindings && pnpm run check:rooms && pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name weichseltree --branch main
scripts.quality: pnpm test && node --test scripts/quality-browser-support.test.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm quality:build
scripts.quality:all: pnpm quality && pnpm quality:browser --out ../results/quality/demo.json && pnpm quality:browser --dist dist --gzip --out ../results/quality/production.json && pnpm quality:world --out ../results/quality/world.json
